name: dev_benchmark
description: Development evaluation benchmark covering 32 questions across 8 categories for financial document RAG

items.question: What is the invoice number for the Dell Technologies invoice?
items.expected_answer: The invoice number for Dell Technologies is DELL-2026-44102.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must accurately identify the exact string 'DELL-2026-44102'.

items.question: What cashier name is listed on the BestBuy receipt?
items.expected_answer: The cashier name listed on the BestBuy receipt is Rahul M.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must return 'Rahul M.'.

items.question: What is the store number for Whole Foods Market?
items.expected_answer: The store is Downtown Market #102 in Seattle, WA.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must mention '#102' or 'Downtown Market #102'.

items.question: What is the order or invoice ID for the Staples office supplies purchase?
items.expected_answer: The order/invoice ID is STP-5521.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must extract 'STP-5521'.

items.question: What was the exact total amount paid for the BestBuy electronics receipt?
items.expected_answer: The total amount paid was INR 8,729.64.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must state 8729.64 and specify Indian Rupees (INR).

items.question: How much did the DeWalt 20V Cordless Drill Kit cost at Home Depot?
items.expected_answer: The DeWalt 20V Cordless Drill Kit cost $119.00.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must state $119.00.

items.question: What was the sales tax amount on the Whole Foods Market receipt?
items.expected_answer: The sales tax on the Whole Foods receipt was $1.11 (6.0%).
items.evaluation_criteria: Must specify $1.11.

items.question: What was the total charges before tax on the Amazon Web Services bill?
items.expected_answer: The total charges before tax were $84.50 USD.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must state $84.50.

items.question: Which single item was the most expensive among all my hardware and electronics purchases?
items.expected_answer: The most expensive item was the Dell UltraSharp 32 4K USB-C Hub Monitor (U3223QE) priced at $850.00.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must rank items and identify the Dell UltraSharp monitor at $850.00.

items.question: Which vendor charged the lowest total across all my receipts?
items.expected_answer: Starbucks Coffee Company charged the lowest total at $14.25.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must identify Starbucks ($14.25) as lowest total.

items.question: Between AWS and GitHub, which cloud or software subscription invoice had a higher total?
items.expected_answer: Amazon Web Services (AWS) had a higher total ($84.50) compared to GitHub ($39.00).
items.evaluation_criteria: Must name AWS and contrast $84.50 with $39.00.

items.question: What was my second highest USD invoice overall?
items.expected_answer: The Home Depot invoice was the second highest USD invoice at $148.80 (behind Dell at $1,450.00).
items.evaluation_criteria: Must identify Home Depot at $148.80 as second to Dell.

items.question: What is the total combined amount spent on cloud and software subscriptions across AWS and GitHub?
items.expected_answer: The total combined amount is $123.50 USD ($84.50 from AWS + $39.00 from GitHub).
items.evaluation_criteria: Must correctly calculate $123.50 ($84.50 + $39.00).

items.question: How much was spent in total on groceries at Whole Foods Market?
items.expected_answer: A total of $19.57 was spent at Whole Foods Market.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must state $19.57.

items.question: What is the combined total of my two Indian Rupee (INR) receipts from BestBuy and Staples?
items.expected_answer: The combined total in INR is 11,192.52 (BestBuy INR 8,729.64 + Staples INR 2,462.88).
items.evaluation_criteria: Must sum 8729.64 and 2462.88 to equal INR 11,192.52.

items.question: How much did I spend in total on coffee and snacks at Starbucks?
items.expected_answer: The total spent at Starbucks was $14.25.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must state $14.25.

items.question: What receipts or invoices did I have in October 2026?
items.expected_answer: In October 2026, there were three invoices: GitHub on 2026-10-01 ($39.00), The Home Depot on 2026-10-04 ($148.80), and Dell Technologies on 2026-10-10 ($1,450.00).
items.evaluation_criteria: Must list GitHub, Home Depot, and Dell, and exclude September invoices.

items.question: What was my total spending in September 2026 in USD?
items.expected_answer: The total spending in USD for September 2026 was $118.32 (Starbucks $14.25 + Whole Foods $19.57 + AWS $84.50).
items.evaluation_criteria: Must calculate $118.32 and exclude INR receipts and October USD receipts.

items.question: Did I make any purchases on September 15, 2026?
items.expected_answer: Yes, on September 15, 2026, a purchase was made at BestBuy Electronics for INR 8,729.64.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must confirm purchase at BestBuy on 2026-09-15.

items.question: What was my earliest purchase in September 2026?
items.expected_answer: The earliest purchase was at Starbucks on September 8, 2026, for $14.25.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must identify Starbucks on 2026-09-08 as earliest.

items.question: Which credit cards were used across my BestBuy and Staples purchases?
items.expected_answer: BestBuy was paid using a Visa Credit Card ending in 4412, and Staples was paid using a Mastercard ending in 9102.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must cite both Visa ending in 4412 and Mastercard ending in 9102.

items.question: List all monitors, docks, or computer mice purchased across all documents.
items.expected_answer: Purchased items include the Logitech MX Master Wireless Mouse from BestBuy, and the Dell UltraSharp 32 4K USB-C Hub Monitor and Dell Thunderbolt 4 Dock from Dell Technologies.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must aggregate computer peripherals from both BestBuy and Dell.

items.question: Which vendors provided zero-tax or tax-exempt invoices?
items.expected_answer: Amazon Web Services ($0.00 tax), GitHub ($0.00 tax), Dell Technologies (Tax Exempt Entity $0.00), and Starbucks (tax included in price).
items.evaluation_criteria: Must identify AWS, GitHub, and Dell Technologies as $0 tax/tax-exempt.

items.question: What payment methods were used for my USD transactions?
items.expected_answer: Payment methods included Apple Pay (Visa 8810) at Whole Foods, Cash at Home Depot, Corporate Amex 1004 for AWS and GitHub, Bank Wire Transfer for Dell, and Starbucks Rewards Card for Starbucks.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must synthesize payment methods across multiple USD receipts.

items.question: What is the purchase order (PO) number for the Starbucks receipt?
items.expected_answer: The Starbucks receipt does not contain a purchase order (PO) number.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must explicitly abstain and state that no PO number is available on the receipt.

items.question: What is the shipping address for the Whole Foods grocery receipt?
items.expected_answer: The Whole Foods receipt is an in-store receipt and does not specify a shipping address.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must explicitly state that no shipping address is present.

items.question: What discount promo code was applied on the Dell Technologies invoice?
items.expected_answer: The Dell Technologies invoice does not mention any discount promo code.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must state that no promo code or discount is indicated.

items.question: What is the flight number and airline listed on the Home Depot receipt?
items.expected_answer: The Home Depot receipt is a hardware store receipt and does not contain flight or airline information.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must abstain and indicate this information is not found in the documents.

items.question: What was my largest payment?
items.expected_answer: This depends on the currency: In USD, the largest payment was $1,450.00 to Dell Technologies. In INR, the highest numerical payment was INR 8,729.64 to BestBuy Electronics.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must clarify the currency ambiguity (distinguishing Dell $1,450.00 vs BestBuy INR 8,729.64).

items.question: How much did I pay for the mouse?
items.expected_answer: The Logitech MX Master Wireless Mouse cost INR 6,499.00 before tax (or part of the INR 8,729.64 total receipt at BestBuy).
evidence_snippets: Logitech MX Master Wireless Mouse - Qty: 1 - INR 6499.00
items.evaluation_criteria: Must mention INR 6,499.00 and specify it was at BestBuy.

items.question: What did I buy at the store?
items.expected_answer: Multiple physical store purchases were made: BestBuy (Mouse and Cable), Whole Foods (Avocados, Milk, Bread, Strawberries), Home Depot (Drill Kit, Tape Measure, Screwdriver Set), Staples (Paper, Pens, Stapler), and Starbucks (Latte, Macchiato, Croissant).
items.evaluation_criteria: Must acknowledge ambiguity across stores or summarize the main physical store purchases.

items.question: Did I pay any tax?
items.expected_answer: Yes, sales tax/GST was paid on several receipts: INR 1,331.64 at BestBuy, INR 263.88 at Staples, $4.86 at Home Depot, and $1.11 at Whole Foods. AWS, GitHub, and Dell had $0 tax, while Starbucks had tax included.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must answer yes and cite specific tax amounts across receipts.
